Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; colors and shapes resolve to the first selected page, stop, yield and speed limit signs to the second, reduced speed, lane use, do not pass and no passing zone signs to the third, pass with care, alignment and exclusion signs to the fourth, other regulatory signs and the warning sign introduction to the fifth, the school and signal warnings and guide signs to the sixth, and the work zone devices to the seventh, eighth and ninth.

Confidence: high across the section; every sign rule is printed as text beside its picture, and the statements restate the printed text and the printed captions, not the pictures themselves. The warning sign examples are named exactly as their captions read.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
